content: En Seremaia Pakair ong Kadaudok en Nanmwarki kan en Suda

KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie I en patohla ni tehnpesen nanmwarkien Suda, me kisehn kadaudok en Depit, oh patohwanohng nanmwarkio, sapwellime lapalap ako, oh mehn Serusalem kan, re en rong dahme KAUN-O ketin mahsaniher:

“Ngehi, KAUN-O, I koasoanediong kumwail en kin wiahda dahme mwahu oh pwung. Kumwail apwalih aramas me meteikan kin pitipitih. Kumwail dehr wiakauwe de kapwalihala mehn liki kan, me sepwoupwou kan, de liohdi kan; oh dehr kemehla aramas me soh dipe wasa sarawi wet.

Ma kumwail pahn kapwaiada ei koasoandi wet, eri, kadaudok en Depit kan pahn usehlahte wiewia nanmwarki. Oh irail, iangahki lapalap akan oh sapwellimarail aramas akan, pahn usehlahte pedolong nan ewen kehl kan en tehnpas wet, dake werennansapw oh oahs akan.
Ahpw ma kumwail sohte pahn kapwaiada ei koasoandi wet, eri, I kahukihla me tehnpas wet pahn pwupwudi ohla. Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.
“Ong ie, tehnpesen nanmwarkien Suda inenen lingan duwehte sapwen Kilead, oh duwehte nahna kan en Lepanon; ahpw I pahn wiahkihla wasa tehn, wasa me sohte aramas kin kousoan ie.
I pahn kadarewei aramas ekei me pahn kauwehla tehnpaso. Re pahn wa kohwei nair sile kan, pelehdi uhr Sidar kaselel kan loale, oh keselahng nan kisiniei.
“Mwuhr, mehn liki tohto pahn keid wasaht oh wiapene peidek wet, dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, ketin wiahkidahr soahng wet ong kahnimw lapalap wet.
Re ahpw pahn sapengki, pwehki amwail kauwehla amwail inou ong ie, amwail Koht, oh kaudokiong oh papah koht teikan.”
En Seremaia eh Pakair duwen Soahas

content.text: Mehn Suda kan, kumwail dehr sengisengki Nanmwarki Sosaia;
kumwail dehr mwahieiki eh pwoula.
Ahpw kumwail sengisengki kowahlap sapwellime pwutak Soahas;
me samwalahr solahr pahn pwurodo,
solahr pahn pwurehng kilang sahpw me e ipwidi ie.

content: KAUN-O ketin mahsanih duwen Soahas, nein Sosaia pwutak me wiliandi eh pahpa wiahla nanmwarkien Suda. “E samwalahr, solahr pahn pwurodo wasaht.
E pahn sipalla nan wehi me e wisiklahng ie, oh e sohte pahn pwurehng mahsanih sahpwet.”
En Seremaia eh Pakair duwen Sehoakim

content.text: Meid suwediong aramas me kin kauwada imwe pohn pwuhng sapahrek,
oh kin katelapahkihla mwersuwed;
me kin koadoadoahkih mehn mpe kan
oh sohte kihong pweinen ar doadoahk.
Meid suwediong aramas me kin nda,
“I pahn kauwada imwei ehu lapalahn ihmwen
me pere laud kei pahn mi nan poasoake powe.”
Ih eri kihong wenihmwtok kei ni imweo,
mesendidkihda tuhke sidar,
oh litopwiheki litopw weitahta.
Ia duwe, komw kupwukupwure me komwi pahn wiahla nanmwarki mwahu men
ma komw kaukihda tehnpasomwi tuhke sidar,
me lingansang tehnpesen meteikan?
Semomwio sapwellimaniki ieias kaselel.
E kin pwung oh inen ahnsou koaros,
oh e kin pweida ni mehkoaros me e kin wia.
E kin ketikihong me semwehmwe kan pwuhng pahrek,
oh mehkoaros kin pweida reh.
Met iei duwen wehwehki KAUN-O.
Ahpw komwi kin rapahkihte kamwahupomwi;
komwi kemehla me soh dipe kan
oh kapwalihala kowahlap sapwellimomwi aramas akan.
KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.

content: Eri, KAUN-O ahpw mahsanih duwen Sehoiakim, nein Sosaia, nanmwarkien Suda,

content.text: “Sohte me pahn mwahieiki eh pwoula de nda,
‘I ahpw poakehla, I ahpw poakehla, kompoakepahio!’
Sohte me pahn sengisengki de palapalakahski,
‘Ei kaun, ei nanmwarki!’
Eh seridi pahn duwehte seridi en ahs emen
me pahn wurahdekieila
oh lekdekla likin ewen kelen Serusalem.”

content: En Seremaia eh Pakair duwen Imwilahn Serusalem

content.text: Kumwail mehn Serusalem kan, kumwail kohla Lepanon oh weriwer,
kumwail kohla nan sapwen Pasan oh likwer;
kumwail likwersang nin nahna kan en Mohap,
pwehki kompoakepahmwail kan koaros lohdier.
KAUN-O mahseniong kumwail ni ahnsou me kumwail paiamwahwo,
kumwail ahpw soikala, sohte men rong.
Ihme kumwail kin wiewia erein amwail mour;
kumwail sohte mwahn kin peikiong KAUN-O.
Kisinieng pahn ipirala amwail kaun akan,
kompoakepahmwail kan pahn wisiksang nin duwen me selidi kei nan mahwen,
amwail kahnimwo pahn sarohdi oh namenekla
pwehki suwed kan me kumwail wiadahr.
Kumwail me kin komkommoal ni meleilei nanpwungen tuhke sidar kan me wisikdohsang Lepanon;
ahpw ia uwen amwail pahn tihwohla ahnsou me medek pahn lel kumwail,
medek me pahn rasehng medek en neitik.

content: Sapwellimen Koht Kadeik ong Sehoiakin
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Nanmwarki Sehoiakin, sapwellimen Sehoiakim pwutak, nanmwarkien Suda. Nin duwen ngehi, Koht ieias, mehnda ma komwi me nei rihng en palimaun, ahpw I pahn keseikomwilahng
rehn aramas akan me komw kin masak, aramas akan me men kemeikomwihla. I pahn ketikinkomwilahng rehn Nepukadnesar, nanmwarkien Papilonia, oh sapwellime sounpei kan.
I pahn kalipeikomwihla oh omwi nohno. Kumwa pahn ketilahng nan wehi ehu me kumwa sohte ipwidi ie, oh kumwa koaros pahn sipalla wasao.
Kumwail pahn loalleidkihda sahpwet, ahpw kumwa sohte pahn sapahldo ie.”

I ahpw patohwan, “Ia duwe, Nanmwarki Sehoiakin wialahr sah ohla ehu me lekdeklahr oh solahr me anahne? Ih kahrepen ih oh sapwellime seri kan kalipilipkilahr nan sahpw ehu me sohte emen kin rong duwe?”

content.text: Oh sahpw, sahpw, sahpw!
Rong dahme KAUN-O ketin mahsanih:
“Ohl menet milahr pahn keria ehu oh solahr pahn neitik seri,
e sohte pahn pweida nan eh mour.
Sohte pahn kadaudoke
me pahn kaunda Suda
nin duwen wiliepen Depit.
Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.”
